title: Authoring Quality Gate — Mandatory Workflow for All 800-Series Items

workflow.name: Draft
workflow.description: Item is authored with stem, 4 choices (A-D), CorrectChoice, ExplanationCorrect, ExplanationWrong[A-D], DifficultyScore, CognitiveLevel, Topics, LOSTag.
workflow.entryCriteria: None — all new items start here
workflow.exitCriteria: All required fields present. Stem and choices are complete. Author self-review complete.

workflow.name: Technical Review
workflow.description: Automated + human review for structural compliance and defect detection.

checks.method: Automated — verify EW field at CC index is '' or missing
checks.severity: BLOCK — item cannot advance with DL-008

checks.description: All ExplanationWrong fields for non-CorrectChoice distractors must be non-empty
checks.method: Automated — verify EW fields at non-CC indices have content ≥ 50 chars

checks.description: No template boilerplate in any ExplanationCorrect or ExplanationWrong field
checks.method: Automated — scan for '[Explanation of why', '[This is', placeholder brackets

checks.description: ExplanationCorrect topic matches stem topic (no cross-contamination)
checks.method: Human review — compare EC content against stem scenario topic

checks.description: All metadata fields present: QuestionID, Topic, DifficultyScore, CognitiveLevel, LOSTag, ProductionStatus
checks.method: Automated — verify all required keys exist and are non-null

workflow.name: Blueprint Review
workflow.description: Verify alignment with IMA CMA Part 1 Content Specification Outline.

checks.description: Item topic matches a specific Section E or F CSO LOS
LOSTag references a precise CSO outcome (e.g., 'F.2.a') not generic section label
CognitiveLevel matches the actual cognitive demand of the item
checks.method: Independent reviewer classifies against Bloom's taxonomy

checks.description: DifficultyScore matches actual cognitive demand and LOS verb depth
checks.method: Independent reviewer — definition-recall = Easy, multi-step = Difficult

checks.description: Item tests CMA Part 1 material, not Part 2 concepts
checks.method: Verify topic is in Part 1 CSO, not Part 2

workflow.name: QA Review
workflow.description: Pedagogical quality and learner experience review.

checks.description: Stem is unambiguous, contains all needed data, no trick wording
checks.method: Human review — can a competent CMA candidate answer without guessing what's being asked?

checks.description: All distractors are plausible alternatives, not obviously wrong
checks.method: Human review — would a knowledgeable but imperfect learner plausibly select each distractor?

checks.description: EC ≥ 400 chars. Includes framework citation, substantive reasoning, common exam trap identified
checks.method: Human review — is this explanation teaching something or just confirming the answer?

checks.description: Each EW is choice-specific and explains WHY that specific choice is wrong
checks.method: Human review — could this EW apply to a different distractor? If yes, it's too generic

checks.description: CorrectChoice is independently verified against authoritative sources
checks.method: Independent verification — second reviewer confirms answer without seeing author's CorrectChoice first

workflow.who: QA Reviewer (independent from author and blueprint reviewer)

workflow.name: Certification Candidate
workflow.description: Item has passed all four gates. Ready for batch certification session.
workflow.who: Session lead — batch promotes Certification Candidate → Certified in certification session

governanceRulesEnforced.dl008: Rule 2 (BLOCK) — EW[CC] must be empty — caught at Technical Review
governanceRulesEnforced.dl026: Empty distractor slots — caught at Technical Review
governanceRulesEnforced.dl013: Template boilerplate — caught at Technical Review
governanceRulesEnforced.dl010: Cross-contaminated explanations — caught at Technical Review
governanceRulesEnforced.dl031: Difficulty inflation — caught at Blueprint Review
governanceRulesEnforced.caqs16: Six-dimension verification — distributed across Technical, Blueprint, and QA Review gates

integrationWith800Series.perSession: Every 800-series session (S804+) must apply this 5-gate workflow to all new or modified items
integrationWith800Series.reviewerIndependence: Author, Technical Reviewer, Blueprint Reviewer, and QA Reviewer must be different individuals (or different sessions for solo operator)
integrationWith800Series.batchCertification: Items that reach 'Certification Candidate' state are batched for certification in dedicated certification sessions (max 30 per batch per Rule 5)
integrationWith800Series.revisionHistory: Each gate transition → REVISION_HISTORY.md entry per AGENTS.md §4 and Rule 1
integrationWith800Series.backupProtocol: Backup-before-write mandatory per AGENTS.md §3 for all write operations
